notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
Hey, guys!

It's Winter Sale, so consider buying my games! And not just buying, I encourage you to actually play them!

Not your kind of games? Well, you still can help me by telling your friends about them, they may be into them!

There are also 2 types of bundles (see below)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/682780/Breaking_Good/

I sincerely hope you will enjoy my games!

Merry Christmas!
